name: Zodiac
tagline: A twenty-creator collab built around the astrological wheel.

facts.note: Reached #1 on the Demonlist, taking the position from Bloodlust. xander556 claimed the verification on 28 January 2019 and admitted on 11 June 2019 that he had hacked it; the title passed to Technical, who had beaten it legitimately on 9 April 2019. Published on xander556's account until it was moved to BIANOX's on 14 October 2021.

spotlight.sub: Taking the position from Bloodlust. Four months later the verifier admitted he had hacked it, and the title passed to Technical, who had already beaten it legitimately.

voice.why:
Zodiac feels like an epic, sprawling odyssey. As a former Top 1 Demon, BIANOX and the team created a monumental three-minute journey set to Creo's “Sphere.” It is heavily segmented, with each creator bringing a distinct astrological theme and design to their part, yet the transitions are smooth enough that it feels like one massive, cohesive gauntlet.

The sheer intimidation factor of having to clear legendary choke points — like Enlex's infamous part, or Xander's brutal finale — makes passing Zodiac a true rite of passage for top players.
